hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Replace question marks greedily to create the largest valid 12-hour time from 00:00 through 11:59.

hints.title: Hour Constraints
hints.text: Hours range from 00 to 11. If the first digit is unknown, pick 1 if the second digit is 0, 1, or unknown; otherwise pick 0.

hints.title: Minute Constraints
hints.text: Minutes range from 00 to 59. Set first minute digit to 5 and second minute digit to 9 if unknown.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle edge conditions on 12-hour time bounds accurately.
